description: This file defines the 'CallableArgumentsExtractor' class, a utility within the Twig templating engine used for extracting and processing function or method call arguments, handling named, positional, variadic, and default arguments, and generating syntax errors for invalid argument usage.

classes.name: CallableArgumentsExtractor
classes.description: A utility class to extract, validate, and process arguments passed to callables in Twig templates, supporting named, positional, optional, variadic, and default arguments, with syntax error handling.

methods.name: extractArguments
methods.description: Extracts and validates arguments for a callable, handling named, positional, optional, variadic arguments, and throws syntax errors for invalid argument usage.

methods.name: normalizeName
methods.description: Converts argument names to lowercase and removes underscores for consistent comparison.

methods.name: toSnakeCase
methods.description: Converts a string from CamelCase to snake_case.

methods.name: getCallableParameters
methods.description: Retrieves and adjusts the callable's parameters, accounting for special parameters like environment, context, and handling variadic parameters.
